name: The Blackout
objective: Hollyhollow suddenly loses power. The entire village goes dark — Team Krampus is attacking the town. Fight through three battles in the first multi-battle quest.
intro: One moment the festival lanterns are glowing. The next, Hollyhollow is black as the inside of a cave — and crimson uniforms are moving between the houses.
dialogue: Krampus Enforcer (defeated): "The blackout was never the point. You've lost already."
lore_discovery: After the final battle you discover that the blackout was a distraction. Team Krampus has stolen something from the village.
